title: Proteomic analysis of 7-octenoic acid antifibrotic effects in TGF-beta1 activated hepatic stellate cells.
authors: Buakaew, Watunyoo; Srimueang, Kittipong; Sutana, Pornsuda; Thongsri, Yordhathai; Potup, Pachuen; Daowtak, Krai; Krobthong, Sucheewin; Yingchutrakul, Yodying; Ferrante, Antonio; Usuwanthim, Kanchana
one_liner_zh: 该文研究7-辛烯酸的抗纤维化作用机制，涉及TGF-beta1信号通路和蛋白组学，但无蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Liver fibrosis represents the liver's adaptive response to sustained and intense inflammation triggered by diverse insults, ranging from dietary factors to infectious agents. Although early-stage fibrosis can be reversible, unchecked progression often leads to cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma. Therapeutic options remain limited, highlighting the pressing need for novel anti‑fibrotic agents. In this study, we evaluated the in vitro anti‑fibrotic effects of 7‑octenoic acid (7‑OCT), a bioactive constituent from Moringa oleifera Lam. Human hepatic stellate LX‑2 cells were stimulated with TGF‑beta1 (10 ng/mL) in the presence or absence of 7‑OCT. Fibrotic marker expression was quantified at both the mRNA and protein levels. Comprehensive proteomic profiling and subsequent in silico docking analyses were performed to identify putative molecular targets and clarify mechanisms of action. Our results demonstrate that 7‑OCT significantly suppresses the expression of alpha‑smooth muscle actin (alpha‑SMA), collagen type I, and matrix metalloproteinase‑9 (MMP‑9) by downregulating transforming growth factor beta receptor 1 (TGFBR1) expression and inhibiting mothers against decapentaplegic homolog 3 (SMAD3) phosphorylation. Proteomic data implicates focal adhesion pathway proteins in mediating these effects. Collectively, these findings suggest that 7‑OCT is a promising lead compound for the development of anti‑fibrotic therapies.
abstract_zh: 肝纤维化是肝脏对多种损伤因素（从饮食因素到感染因子）引发的持续且强烈炎症的适应性反应。尽管早期纤维化是可逆的，但不受控制的进展常导致肝硬化和肝细胞癌。治疗选择仍然有限，凸显了对新型抗纤维化药物的迫切需求。在本研究中，我们评估了来自辣木（Moringa oleifera Lam.）的生物活性成分7-辛烯酸（7-OCT）的体外抗纤维化效果。人肝星状LX-2细胞在有无7-OCT的情况下，用TGF-β1（10 ng/mL）刺激。纤维化标志物的表达在mRNA和蛋白质水平上均被定量。进行了全面的蛋白质组学分析和随后的计算机模拟对接分析，以识别推定的分子靶点并阐明作用机制。我们的结果表明，7-OCT通过下调转化生长因子β受体1（TGFBR1）表达并抑制母亲对抗十肢麻痹同源物3（SMAD3）磷酸化，显著抑制α-平滑肌肌动蛋白（α-SMA）、I型胶原蛋白和基质金属蛋白酶-9（MMP-9）的表达。蛋白质组学数据提示，黏着斑通路蛋白在介导这些效应中起作用。综合来看，这些发现表明7-OCT是开发抗纤维化治疗的有前景的先导化合物。
